gallery.filename: The front page of the Cipanas Palace in Cianjur Regency.jpg
gallery.title: File:The front page of the Cipanas Palace in Cianjur Regency.jpg
gallery.description: Cipanas Palace is located at the foot of Mount Gede, precisely in Cianjur Regency, originally a residence that was founded in 1740, by Van Heots. During the reign of the Dutch East Indies, to be precise the government of Governor General G.W. Baron van Imhoff (1743). After Indonesia's independence, this building was officially designated as one of the Presidential Palaces of the Republic of Indonesia.
